scripts.build:klyo: VITE_TARGET=klyo vite build --outDir dist-klyo && rm -f dist-klyo/audio/bgm.mp3 dist-klyo/playgama-bridge-config.json dist-klyo/assets/firebase-*.js && cp -r klyo/CREDITS.md klyo/LICENSES dist-klyo/ && rm -f void-survivors-klyo.zip && cd dist-klyo && zip -qr ../void-survivors-klyo.zip .
scripts.build:android: vite build && rm -rf dist-app && cp -r dist dist-app && rm -f dist-app/audio/bgm.mp3 dist-app/playgama-bridge-config.json && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android:test: VITE_ADS_TEST=1 vite build && rm -rf dist-app && cp -r dist dist-app && rm -f dist-app/audio/bgm.mp3 dist-app/playgama-bridge-config.json && npx cap sync android
